title.purpose: Section headings in prose and major blocks.

body.purpose: All paragraphs, form values, table cells.

label.purpose: Kickers, table headers, chips, badges, tabs.

button.purpose: Buttons and links styled as actions.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Active press on buttons; never moves surrounding layout.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Ink-filled action; inverts to paper on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn { font-family: 'Cairo Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1rem; padding: 0.9rem 1.75rem; border: 2px solid #15130f; background: #15130f; color: #f7f5f0; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease-out, color 0.15s ease-out, border-color 0.15s ease-out, transform 0.08s ease-out; } .ds-btn:hover { background: transparent; color: #15130f; } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #962567; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Paper-filled secondary action; fills with ink on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { font-family: 'Cairo Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1rem; padding: 0.9rem 1.75rem; border: 2px solid #15130f; background: transparent; color: #15130f; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease-out, color 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #15130f; color: #f7f5f0; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #962567; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Square ink-bordered field with an accent focus outline.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 0.45rem; font-family: 'Tajawal', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #15130f; } .ds-field span { font-family: 'Cairo Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.8125rem; } .ds-field input { font: inherit; font-size: 1rem; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.65rem 0.75rem; border: 2px solid #15130f; border-radius: 0; background: #f7f5f0; color: #15130f; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #962567; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Square outlined status label; green for confirmed, muted for pending.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; padding: 0.2rem 0.65rem; border: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, #15130f 25%, #f7f5f0); font-family: 'Cairo Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.8125rem; color: #6f6a62; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-chip-ok { border-color: #2e6b3e; color: #2e6b3e; }

components.name: Ledger Card
components.description: Paper surface defined by a 2px ink border; no shadow, no radius.
components.css: .ds-card { border: 2px solid #15130f; background: #f7f5f0; padding: 1.25rem; display: grid; gap: 0.75rem; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0; padding-bottom: 0.6rem; border-bottom: 2px solid #15130f; font-family: 'Cairo Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 1rem; color: #15130f; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; font-family: 'Tajawal', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.8; color: #15130f; }

narrative.overview:
The site reads like a well-kept clinical record: warm paper, dark ink, ruled edges, and numbers that line up. Nothing floats. Every boundary is a drawn line — 1px hairlines between sections, 2px ink rules around anything you can press or fill in — so the page feels documented rather than decorated.

The subject is life-threatening, so the interface stays quiet and certain: one chromatic voice, generous Arabic leading, and typography that does the work that imagery usually does. Earned seriousness, never alarm.

Depth is paper, not shadow. A surface rises by gaining a border, an ink fill, or white space around it. There is exactly one exception in the whole system: the sticky site header, which blurs whatever is scrolled beneath it.
keyCharacteristics: Warm off-white paper #f7f5f0 against near-black ink #15130f
One accent, #962567, used sparingly and purposefully
2px borders on interactive surfaces; 1px hairlines for structure
Zero corner radius, zero drop shadows, zero gradients
Cairo for anything that speaks; Tajawal for anything that reads
RTL native: logical properties everywhere, taller Arabic line-height

rules.name: The Rationed Mark Rule
rules.body: The accent may cover no more than roughly a tenth of any screen. If a screen needs more emphasis, use ink weight and size first; the magenta is a signature, not a highlighter.

rules.name: The No Second Hue Rule
rules.body: There are exactly two colors of meaning besides ink and paper: magenta for attention and green for confirmation. No amber, no blue, no teal.

rules.name: The Arabic Leading Rule
rules.body: Body leading never drops below 1.7. If a component feels loose, reduce the measure, not the line-height.

rules.name: The No Tracking Rule
rules.body: Never apply letter-spacing to Arabic text. Letter spacing is reserved for Latin ticket codes rendered with dir="ltr".

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Cairo speaks (headings, buttons, labels, numbers that carry meaning); Tajawal reads (paragraphs, form values, table cells). Never set a paragraph in Cairo or a heading in Tajawal.

rules.name: The Flat By Default Rule
rules.body: If a surface needs to feel raised, give it a border, not a shadow.

dos: Do default every surface to Warm Paper with a drawn border; depth comes from rules and ink fills.
Do use 2px ink borders on interactive elements and 1px Rule Line for structure.
Do keep the accent rare, semantic, and purposeful — attention, confirmation contrast, focus.
Do write layout with logical properties (margin-inline, padding-block, inset-inline-start) so RTL is native.
Do keep body leading at 1.8 and cap measures at 68ch for prose.
Do give every control a 44px touch height and a visible accent focus ring.
Do use real photographs, the alliance logo assets, and Cairo/Tajawal only.
donts: Don't add shadows, blurs (beyond the header), or gradients.
Don't round corners or introduce a second accent hue.
Don't set Arabic text in uppercase, letter-spaced, or below 1.7 leading.
Don't use emoji as icons or mix icon libraries.
Don't fill cards with white or a tint — paper plus a border is the card.
Don't invent statistics, testimonials, partner logos, or donation channels to fill a layout.
Don't add a new breakpoint before checking 720px and 1100px.
